commits.comment: 该 BugFix 针对 ACL Graph 捕获中 MoE 内部路由每次前向执行 `gate.weight.to(torch.float32)` 产生 `aclop Cast` 的问题。实现上复用了现有 `precast_fp32_weight` 机制：在 AscendMoERunner.__init__ 中对 gate 设置 `precast_fp32_weight = True`，使 asc 权重在 `process_weights_after_loading` 阶段预生成 `weight_fp32`；forward 热路径则移除 `hasattr(gate, 'weight_fp32')` 的 fallback，直接使用 `gate.weight_fp32`，从而避免 ACL Graph 捕获依赖实时 Cast。同时将 AscendGateLinear 构造改为直接基于 AscendReplicatedLinear，跳过上游 GateLinear.__init__ 的 CUDA/ROCm GEMM probes，并在 utils.py 中无条件注册 AscendGateLinear，使所有 MoE 模型（而非仅 DeepSeek MLA）都使用 FP32 路由权重计算。风险点在于若某个 gate 的加载路径未正确处理 `precast_fp32_weight`，forward 时访问 `weight_fp32` 会直接 AttributeError；不过 AscendGateLinear 全局注册后所有内部 router gate 均走该实现，风险可控。整体改动清晰，测试覆盖了主要路径，但仍需真实设备上确认 Qwen3-VL W8A8 Nightly 修复效果。

test_impact.reason: 代码变更改变了 gate 权重预转换的生命周期和注册范围，forward 热路径不再有 fallback，现有测试已新增覆盖 init precast 设置、已有 weight_fp32 跳过、无 gate 跳过、普通/共享专家 forward 路径以及 GateLinear 输出 dtype。但 GateLinear 从条件注册改为全局注册影响面扩大，需要增加针对非 DeepSeek MLA 模型的回归测试，因此建议继续补充真实设备端到端用例。

commits.message:
[BugFix] Precast MoE gate weight_fp32 to avoid aclop Cast (#16189)

### What this PR does / why we need it?

Nightly `qwen3-vl-235b-a22b-instruct-w8a8` (A3, `FULL_DECODE_ONLY`
ACLGraph) fails because internal-router MoE recomputes logits with:

`gate.weight.to(torch.float32)`

That emits a per-forward `aclop Cast`. DeepSeek-V4 and 310P already
avoid this by setting `gate.precast_fp32_weight = True` so
`AscendUnquantizedLinearMethod.process_weights_after_loading`
materializes `weight_fp32` at load time.

This PR applies the same precast in `AscendMoERunner.__init__` for all
Ascend platforms, and routes the hot path through `_gate_weight_fp32()`
so ACLGraph capture no longer depends on a live Cast.

### Does this PR introduce _any_ user-facing change?

No.

### How was this patch tested?

- Code-path review against 310P `AscendMoERunner310` and DeepSeek-V4
`precast_fp32_weight`.
- Nightly should re-run `Qwen3-VL-235B-A22B-Instruct-W8A8`.
